note: Connecticut has no county government, so there are no region-wide offices or measures. Only City of Norwich and City of New London items are shown. Neither city's November 2026 sample ballot has a Registrar of Voters race; New London's has no local ballot question. Chuck Norris (Norwich) and Mathew H. Greene (New London) each appear on both the Democratic and Republican lines. Other towns in the Southeastern Connecticut Planning Region elect their own Judge of Probate by probate district and may have Registrar of Voters races or local questions; check your town's official sample ballot.

measures.title: Police Headquarters Facility Project: $55,000,000 appropriation and bond authorization
measures.summary: Asks whether to approve a $55,000,000 appropriation and bond authorization ordinance for planning, acquiring and building the City of Norwich Police Headquarters Facility Project at 300 Main Street (Downtown).
measures.yesMeans: A yes vote approves the $55,000,000 appropriation and borrowing for the new police headquarters at 300 Main Street.
measures.noMeans: A no vote rejects the $55,000,000 appropriation and borrowing for the project.
